title: Open and document the requisition
verification: A requisition record exists in the ATS with role, level, reporting line, and business case.

title: Approve headcount and budget
verification: The requisition shows an approval record with approver, date, and budgeted band.

title: Finalize the job description and selection criteria
verification: Every listed requirement is job-related and consistent with business necessity; the scorecard defines competencies with behavioral anchors.

title: Source candidates
verification: The role is posted to all required channels and a candidate pipeline is building in the ATS.

title: Screen applications
verification: All applicants are screened against the same criteria and screening decisions are logged.

title: Recruiter phone screen
verification: Each candidate is screened with the same core questions; notes are recorded in the ATS.

title: Administer job-related assessments
verification: The same assessment is sent to all candidates for the role and results are recorded.

title: Conduct structured interviews
verification: Every interviewer completes an anchored scorecard with evidence notes; the same core questions were used.

title: Debrief and make the selection decision
verification: The decision and its rationale are documented and stored; the selection-rate is checked against the 4/5 rule.

title: Complete reference checks
verification: References are completed with consistent questions and results are recorded.

title: Approve compensation and extend a conditional verbal offer
verification: Compensation is approved and within band; the conditional verbal offer and its terms are confirmed by email.

title: Candidate response and negotiation
verification: The candidate's response is recorded; any negotiated changes are captured before proceeding.

title: Disclose, authorize, and run the background check
verification: A signed standalone disclosure and authorization are on file before the report is ordered; the report is stored securely.

title: Adjudicate the results
verification: The adjudication applies job-relatedness and an individualized assessment; the rationale is documented.

title: Run FCRA adverse action (only if withdrawing)
verification: Both notices are documented with dates and the waiting period is observed; no irreversible internal action is taken during the waiting period.

title: Extend the formal written offer
verification: The sent offer matches approved terms; non-standard terms were reviewed by Legal; an acceptance deadline is set.

title: Countersign and execute the agreement
verification: Candidate signature and employer countersignature are on file; the start date is confirmed.

title: Initiate right-to-work and hand off to onboarding
verification: Form I-9 is initiated and the onboarding handoff package is delivered to the onboarding owner.
